base_width = 80.0
base_height = 20.0
wall_thickness = 5.0
top_height = 25.0
extrude_depth = 35.0
fillet_radius = 3.0
hole_diameter = 6.0
hole_offset_x = 30.0
hole_offset_y = 30.0
pocket_width = 30.0

pocket_depth = 10.0

slot_center_y = arm_width / 2
